author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a judo athlete bust whose body is now a semicircular sweep over the shoulders with one lapel line, and whose curved hair is replaced by a straight horizontal line across the upper-middle of the head. Bust contact: the jaw bottom (24,30) and the body top (24,34) are aligned cardinal extremes 4 apart (ink touching), with a direct connect.
omissions: The head is larger (r13, was r10) so that the hair line can sit on an integer chord with a legal crown hole above it; the body is correspondingly shallower.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L: head r13 about (24,17) as four arcs split at the chord ends; hair line (12,12)-(36,12); body half-ellipse rx16 ry10 from (8,44) through (24,34) to (40,44); lapel (24,34)-(30,44).
